evaluator_schema:
Exact 7-key set: {intent, scope, requires_retrieval, requires_attachment, content_type, confidence, reasoning}
intent enum: security_block, conversational, direct_answer, explanation, summarization, comparison, analytical_reasoning, content_generation, unclear
scope enum: specific_query, selected_text, section, whole_document, conversation_context, none
requires_retrieval: bool
requires_attachment: bool
content_type: null unless intent=content_generation, else quiz/flashcards/mind_map/slide_deck/practice_questions/study_plan/other
confidence: float 0.0-1.0 (cap 0.70 when scope=conversation_context)
reasoning: string <=40 words
Source: evals/datasets/final_Evalutors/intent_classifier.py
dataset_schema:
Output keys (7): {intent, scope, requires_retrieval, requires_attachment, content_type, confidence, reasoning}
intent gold values used: security_block, conversational, direct_answer, explanation, summarization, comparison, analytical_reasoning, content_generation, unclear
scope gold values: specific_query, selected_text, section, whole_document, conversation_context, none
content_type: null unless content_generation
input_keys: query, source_count
Source: evals/datasets/prompt_tiered/routing/intent_classifier.json
production_schema:
Emits 6 keys: {intent, confidence, reasoning, scope, requires_retrieval, requires_attachment} (no content_type)
intent enum (UserIntent): security_block, conversational, question, explanation, summary, whole_document_summary, comparison, definition, how_to, analysis, creation, general
scope enum: whole_document, section, fact, unspecified
requires_retrieval: bool
requires_attachment: bool
confidence: float 0.0-1.0 (no scope-based cap)
reasoning: string <=60 words
Source: packages/core/rag/agents/intent_classifier.py
evaluator_vs_dataset_diff: ALIGNED - dataset output_keys exactly match the evaluator 7-key set; gold intent/scope values use the same enums; the evaluator was written to validate this dataset
evaluator_vs_production_diff:
key_set DIFFERS - production omits content_type, so evaluator's exact 7-key gate fails
intent DIFFERS - only security_block/conversational/explanation/comparison overlap; evaluator-only: direct_answer, summarization, analytical_reasoning, content_generation, unclear; production-only: question, summary, whole_document_summary, definition, how_to, analysis, creation, general
scope DIFFERS - only section/whole_document overlap; evaluator-only: specific_query, selected_text, conversation_context, none; production-only: fact, unspecified
requires_retrieval SAME
requires_attachment SAME
content_type MISSING IN PRODUCTION
confidence DIFFERS - evaluator enforces conversation_context confidence cap production lacks
reasoning DIFFERS - word limit 40 (eval) vs 60 (prod)
